description: Rain on the sea and the sails: a hiss of high band-passed noise, as small drops ring high on water, its level rising with the logarithm of the rate at the boat from from to full mm an hour; and in heavy rain a lower drumming, as large drops are loud across the whole spectrum, from drumFrom to drumFull mm an hour. Frequencies in Hz, levels as gains.
